scientific_integrity: Proof uses incidence total unimodularity, Smith minors over a DVR, and exact valuation-shell enumeration. Python finite cross-checks are supporting evidence and do not prove arbitrary parameters.
scientific_limitations: Finite graph and fixed positive congruence level; standard graphical groups over quotients of discrete valuation rings. The polynomial expression is not a compact rational zeta function or a complexity bound. Earlier literature may contain equivalent monomial Smith-invariant formulas. Independent mathematical audit is not performed.
title: Spanning-forest valuation formula and positive class-size polynomials at every congruence level of graphical groups
